architecture.title: Architectural Design
architecture.description: This document details the design specifications, reactive model, and pipeline layers for the Generative UI Protocol (GUIP) reference runtime.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.description: Welcome to AI-Native UI Runtime. This documentation describes the universal AST protocol, runtime architecture, and roadmap for AI-generated interfaces.

protocol.title: Protocol Specification
protocol.description: The Generative UI Protocol (GUIP) defines a standardized, compact, and extensible format for representing user interfaces generated by AI models and rendered natively by frontend view frameworks.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.description: - Phase 1: AST, runtime core, React renderer, MCP server
